title: composition
description: The operation that combines two composable morphisms into one, associatively — g after f. What turns a collection of arrows into a structure you can follow paths through. Generated by `composing` morphisms.

composable-pair.description: two morphisms f : A → B and g : B → C sharing the middle object

composite.description: the resulting morphism g ∘ f : A → C

associativity.description: h ∘ (g ∘ f) = (h ∘ g) ∘ f for every composable triple
